name: @buddhilw/plato
description: Data-driven ClojureScript presentation engine powered by Reveal.js and Desargues scene graphs.

scripts.dev: npm run assets && shadow-cljs watch app acme
scripts.build: npm run assets && shadow-cljs release app acme
scripts.e2e: npm run build && shadow-cljs release e2e fit && npm run e2e:export && node target/e2e.js
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.theme: clojure -M:cli theme theme/plato.tokens.edn -o public/css/plato-theme.css --json theme/plato.tokens.json --cljc src/plato/theme.cljc
